0022600111.text: The Suns (0-1, on a one-game losing streak) sit 15th in the West and 5th in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, and host the 0-2 Golden State Warriors, who are 13th in the West and 3rd in the Pacific, 2 games back. The two teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Suns lost the season series 1-3, including a 101-97 home loss on February 5, 2026. Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery), while Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Oso Ighodaro (oblique strain) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions; Golden State is missing Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery).
